mentions.name: Raptor
mentions.description: Raptor is a free software build tool that generates disk images, liveboot ISOs, and container images (Docker/Podman). It supports many build products and uses a syntax inspired by Docker but significantly enhanced.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Raptor - a new (Free software) way to build things like:

* Disk images

* Liveboot isos

* Container images (docker/podman)
